description: Drug approval history (FDA Drugs@FDA) — When and how was a drug approved? Looks up FDA applications (NDA, ANDA generic, BLA biologic) by brand, generic or sponsor name or by application number and returns the sponsor, original approval date, each product with active ingredients and strengths, dosage form, route, marketing status (prescription, OTC, discontinued), reference-drug and therapeutic-equivalence codes, pharmacologic class, the newest submissions (supplements, labeling changes) and a link to the latest label PDF. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

application.description: or an application number, e.g. NDA209637

drug.description: brand, generic or sponsor name, e.g. ozempic
